creative.posterBody: Travis Scott fans can make a real impact. Join our blood drive at POST Houston on Sat, Nov 14. Your donation helps reach our community goal before the campaign ends on Sun, Dec 13. Please check your eligibility before donating and be a hero today.
socialPosts: Travis Scott fans, step up for our community! Join us at POST Houston on Sat, Nov 14. Check your eligibility and help save lives.

pitchEmail.subject: Blood drive partnership opportunity for Travis Scott fans in Houston
pitchEmail.body: Hello community leadership team, We are organizing a local blood drive campaign running through Sun, Dec 13 with a special event on Sat, Nov 14 at POST Houston. We are reaching out to see if local Travis Scott fans would be interested in rallying together to support this lifesaving cause. With a goal of 300 donors, community engagement from local Travis Scott fans would make a tremendous difference. Please let us know if you would like to help spread the word to your members. Thank you for your time and consideration.
